servicesCategoriesDesc.food: Makhaayadaha, kafeegyada, cunto karinta iyo rootiga.

servicesCatalog.svc1Desc: Baaritaan, dayactir qalab iyo xallinta softweerka kombuyuutarada desktop iyo laptop.
servicesCatalog.svc2Desc: Websaytyo gaar ah iyo barnaamijyada webka ee ganacsiyada yaryar iyo hay'adaha.
servicesCatalog.svc3Desc: Casharro wadis oo bilow ilaa heer sare ah oo ay bixiyaan macallimiin shahaado leh.
servicesCatalog.svc4Desc: Koorsooyin gaagaaban oo softweerka xafiiska, aasaaska barnaamijyada iyo aqoonta dijitaalka ah.
servicesCatalog.svc5Desc: Dawooyin laguu qoray iyo kuwa aan qornayn oo ay bixiyaan shaqaale xirfad leh.
servicesCatalog.svc6Desc: Baaritaan, nadiifin, buuxin iyo hababka aasaasiga ah ee ilkaha.
servicesCatalog.svc7Desc: Adeeg tagaasi oo lagu kalsoonaan karo oo maxalli ah iyo mid magaalooyinka dhexdooda ah. Waa la heli karaa wicitaan.
servicesCatalog.svc8Desc: Kirada baabuur iskii-wada ama darawal leh oo loogu talagalay safarada ganacsiga ama shaqsiga.
servicesCatalog.svc9Desc: Cunto maxalli ah iyo mid caalami ah oo lagu bixiyo goob qoysaska ku habboon.
servicesCatalog.svc10Desc: Cunto karinta dhacdooyinka sida aroosyada, shirarka iyo munaasabadaha bulshada.
servicesCatalog.svc11Desc: Hoy la awoodi karo oo habeenkii ah oo leh adeegyo aasaasi ah.
servicesCatalog.svc12Desc: Qolal raaxo leh iyo goobo shirar loogu talagalay safarayaasha ganacsiga.
servicesCatalog.svc13Desc: Alaab tafaariiq ah oo guud oo ay ku jiraan alaabta guriga iyo alaabta daryeelka shaqsiga.
servicesCatalog.svc14Desc: Bixinta alaabta jumlada ah dukaamada, kioskada iyo ganacsiyada yaryar.
servicesCatalog.svc15Desc: Dayactirka TV-yada, raadiyaha, taleefannada iyo qalabka elektarooniga yaryar.
servicesCatalog.svc16Desc: Talaagadaha, mishiinnada dhaqista, kariyayaasha iyo qalabka kale ee guriga.
servicesCatalog.svc17Desc: La-talin sharci iyo adeegyo dokumenti ah oo loogu talagalay shaqsiyaadka iyo ganacsiyada.
servicesCatalog.svc18Desc: Diiwaangelinta buugaagta, soo-jeedinta cashuurta iyo taageerada xisaabaadka ganacsiyada yaryar.
servicesCatalog.svc19Desc: Adeegyada timaha, ciddiyaha, qurxinta iyo daryeelka maqaarka oo lagu bixiyo goob casri ah.
servicesCatalog.svc20Desc: Timaha jarista, xiirista iyo adeegyada qurxinta ragga iyo wiilasha.
servicesCatalog.svc21Desc: Adeegyada dhismaha guryaha la deggan yahay laga bilaabo aasaaska ilaa dhammaystirka.
servicesCatalog.svc22Desc: Rakibidda, dayactirka iyo ilaalinta nidaamyada biyaha iyo bulaacadaha.
servicesCatalog.svc23Desc: Sawirqaadis xirfad leh oo loogu talagalay aroosyada, qalin-jabinta iyo dhacdooyinka shirkadaha.
servicesCatalog.svc24Desc: Qorsheyn buuxda iyo isku-dubarid dhacdooyin gaar ah iyo kuwa dadweynaha.

serviceDetailPage.faq_three_a: Eeg goobta — haddii aad u dhowdahay, la xiriir si aad u xaqiijiso.
serviceDetailPage.faq_four_a: Bixiyayaasha la xaqiijiyay waxay leeyihiin calaamad dahab ah.

communityUpdates.cu1Title: Meel biyo oo cusub oo laga furay Balambala
communityUpdates.cu1Summary: Degmada waxay furtay meel biyo oo cusub oo u adeegta in ka badan 500 qoys oo ku nool Balambala.

testimonials.heading: Codadka GarissaConnect
testimonials.subhead: Dadka deggan, milkiilayaasha ganacsiyada iyo xubnaha bulshada waxay wadaagaan sida madashu u beddesho noloshooda maalinlaha ah.
testimonials.t1Quote: Shaqadaydii ugu horreysay waxaan ka helay GarissaConnect. Waxaan maqli jiray fursadaha goor dambe — hadda waxaan arkaa isla maalinta la soo dhigay.
testimonials.t2Quote: Dukaankayagu wuxuu ku tiirsanaa macaamiisha soo galaya oo keliya. Tan iyo markii aan ku qornay GarissaConnect, dadka degmada oo dhan ayaa na helay.
testimonials.t3Quote: Waxaan fiiriyaa qaybta bulshada subax kasta. Ogeysiisyo, dhacdooyin, wax kasta oo aan u baahanahay — hal meel.

why.heading: Loo dhisay Garissa, dad Garissa fahma
why.para1: GarissaConnect waxay u jirtaa inay nolosha dadka deggan fududeyso, xoojiso ganacsiyada maxalliga ah, oo qof kasta siiso fursad cadaalad ah.
why.para2: Waxaan aaminsanahay in helitaanka macluumaadka uusan waligiis ku xirnaan cidda aad taqaan ama meesha aad ku nooshahay.
why.value1Desc: Isku keenista dadka deggan, hay'adaha iyo ganacsiyada hal meel oo wadaag ah.
why.value2Desc: Ka dhigista shaqooyinka, deeqaha waxbarashada iyo tababarka mid u muuqda qof kasta.
why.value3Desc: Ka caawinta ganacsiyada Garissa inay gaaraan macaamiil badan oo si waara u koraan.
why.value4Desc: Macluumaadka iyo kheyraadka waxtarka leh ee hore loo heli kari waayay, hadda hal meel.
why.value5Desc: Dhiirrigelinta dad badan oo deggan inay ka qaybqaataan dhaqaalaha dijitaalka.

about.heroHeading1: Xarun dijitaal ah oo loo dhisay
about.heroSubhead: GarissaConnect waa madal bulshadu waddo oo isku xirta dadka deggan Degmada Garissa fursadaha, ganacsiyada maxalliga ah, adeegyada, dhacdooyinka iyo macluumaadka ugu muhiimsan.
about.missionText: In macluumaad waxtar leh iyo fursado dhab ah loo heli karo qof kasta oo deggan Degmada Garissa.
about.visionText: Garissa dijitaal ahaan isku xiran halkaas oo qof kasta uu ku ogaan karo, ka qayb qaadan karo oo uu ku kori karo.
about.storyPara1: Sannado badan, macluumaadka ku saabsan shaqooyinka, deeqaha waxbarashada, tababarka, dhacdooyinka bulshada iyo adeegyada maxalliga ah ayaa ku faafay sabuuradaha ogeysiisyada, kooxaha WhatsApp, bogagga baraha bulshada iyo afka. Waxtar leh — laakiin kala qaybsan.
about.storyPara2: GarissaConnect waxaa loo abuuray inay wax walba isku keento hal madal oo la aamini karo oo fudud in la isticmaalo.
about.storyPara3: Tani ma aha oo keliya websayt. Waa meel dijitaal ah oo la wadaago oo loogu talagalay bulshada Garissa.
about.storyPointsHeading: Waxa aan u tallaabsanay in aan hagaajinno
about.storyPoint1: Fursaduhu way jireen, laakiin way adkaayeen in hal meel laga helo.
about.storyPoint2: Ganacsiyada maxalliga ahi waxay u baahnaayeen joogitaan dijitaal ah oo xooggan.
about.storyPoint3: Macluumaadka bulshadu wuxuu ku kala firirsanaa kanaal badan.
about.storyPoint4: Dadka deggan waxay mudnaayeen madal loo qaabeeyay iyadoo loo eegayo baahidooda.
about.whatWeDoHeading: Afar tiir oo madasha isku haya
about.whatWeDoSubhead: Wax walba oo GarissaConnect ku yaal waxay ku soo galaan mid ka mid ah afar meelood.
about.pillar1Desc: Shaqooyin, tababaro, deeqo waxbarasho iyo tababar — oo u muuqda qof kasta oo deggan.
about.pillar2Desc: Guri dijitaal ah oo ganacsiyada Garissa lagu ogaado loona taageero.
about.pillar3Desc: Kulamo, aqoon-is-weydaarsiyo, ogeysiisyo iyo warar ka imanaya degmada oo dhan.
about.pillar4Desc: Hagayaal, dokumenti iyo macluumaad waxtar leh oo lagu ururiyay hal meel oo la aamini karo.
about.valuesHeading: Mabaadi'da qaabaysa wax walba oo aan dhisno
about.valuesSubhead: GarissaConnect ma aha oo keliya software. Waa ballanqaad bulshada.
about.value1Desc: Go'aan kastaa wuxuu ka bilaabmaa hal su'aal: tan ma caawinaysaa dadka deggan Garissa?
about.value2Desc: Socod fudud, luqad cad iyo luqado badan si qofna looga tegin gadaal.
about.value3Desc: Macluumaadka waa la xaqiijiyaa, la cusboonaysiiyaa, oo si cad loo soo bandhigaa.
about.value4Desc: Loo dhisay Garissa — dadkeeda, ganacsiyadeeda iyo xaaladaheeda maalinlaha ah.
about.value5Desc: Waxaan u dhisnaa si tartiib ah oo taxaddar leh si madashu ugu adeegto bulshada sanado badan.
about.journeyHeading: Fikrad ilaa madal bulsho oo koraysa
about.journeySubhead: Tallaabo kasta si taxaddar leh ayaa loo dhisay.
about.journeyM1Desc: Dadka deggan Garissa waxay aqoonsadeen dhibaato fudud: macluumaadka meel walba wuu jiray, laakiin ma ahayn hal meel. Fikradda xarun dijitaal ah oo bulsho ayaa bilaabantay.
about.journeyM2Desc: Bilooyin wada-hadal ah oo lala yeeshay dadka deggan, ardayda, milkiilayaasha ganacsiyada iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada ayaa qaabeeyay waxa madashu noqon lahayd.
about.journeyM3Desc: GarissaConnect waxaa lagu bilaabay fursadaha, ganacsiyada iyo macluumaadka bulshada. Isticmaalayaashii ugu horreeyay waxay heleen qiimo dhab ah maalinta ugu horreysa.
about.journeyM4Desc: Boqolaal dad deggan ayaa ku biiray. Ganacsiyada maxalliga ah waxay bilaabeen inay liis gareeyaan adeegyadooda. Ogeysiisyada bulshada waxay heleen guri lagu kalsoonaan karo.
about.journeyM5Desc: Waxaan ballaarinaynaa madasha — luqado cusub, helitaan cod, taageero USSD iyo SMS — si qof kasta oo deggan, qalab kasta, uu ka qayb qaadan karo.
about.impactSubhead: Tirooyin dhab ah oo ka yimid madal toddobaad kasta la korto bulshada Garissa.
about.teamSubhead: Koox yar oo dadaal u leh inay dhisto madal dhab u adeegta bulshada Garissa.
about.member1Bio: Dhisaya GarissaConnect si uu isugu xiro dadka deggan fursadaha, adeegyada iyo macluumaadka bulshada.
about.member2Bio: Si toos ah ula shaqeeya dadka deggan, odayaasha, dhalinyarada iyo hay'adaha maxalliga ah ee Degmada Garissa oo dhan.
about.member3Bio: Hagaya jihada madasha si ay u ahaato mid fudud, faa'iido leh oo qof kasta heli karo.
about.member4Bio: Isku xira GarissaConnect ganacsiyada maxalliga ah, xafiisyada degmada iyo la-hawlgalayaasha bulshada.
about.partnersHeading: La shaqeynta hay'adaha Garissa oo dhan
about.partnersSubhead: Waxaan dhisaynaa iskaashi la sameyno hay'adaha maxalliga, ganacsiyada iyo kooxaha bulshada.
about.partnersMore: Iskaashi dheeraad ah ayaa dhawaan imanaya marka madashu korto.
about.ctaHeading: Ka mid noqo waxa aan dhisno
about.ctaSubhead: Ku biir dadka deggan, ganacsiyada iyo hay'adaha Garissa oo maalin kasta isticmaala GarissaConnect.
